line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decisions.R1413: Conversion-local journal identifies only newly acquired aliases; two simultaneous conversations can reference the same source. P75 exact-body failure controls verify rollback.
decisions.R1414: Both COPYDATA lookup directions require header discrimination; the P75 embedded-header cases cover payload/header alias collision.
decisions.R1415: Boolean insertion outcome is necessary to retain the outer same-ID node after inner allocation rejection.
decisions.R1416: Restore original header at this point. WM_DDE_INITIATE assigns the complete scratch word from a single boolean in both directions. No concurrent bit in either message field; use the result directly.
decisions.R1417: Retain the explicit journal on conversion/rollback and mark-callback failure result. The original signatures cannot carry the per-call acquisitions or report a denied mark.
